# BasaltDB

> The action ledger for AI agents on your database. Not a database: your data stays in your own Postgres. One Go binary next to each agent, reached over MCP, plus a guard installed in your Postgres that records, holds and reverts agent writes.

The public docs are at https://docs.basaltvault.app. Every page is also Markdown at its path with `.md` in place of the trailing slash (the home page is `/index.md`). The whole site in one file is https://docs.basaltvault.app/llms-full.txt, and the site's own index is https://docs.basaltvault.app/llms.txt.

## Start here

- [What is BasaltDB](https://docs.basaltvault.app/start/what-is-basaltdb.md): what it does for an agent that writes to your Postgres, and where it stops
- [Install](https://docs.basaltvault.app/start/install.md): install basalt and guard the tables your agent may change
- [Quickstart](https://docs.basaltvault.app/start/quickstart.md): let an agent change a sample table, get refused, then undo the run and keep your edit
- [Connect an agent](https://docs.basaltvault.app/start/connect-agent.md): connect OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex or a bot on its own computer over MCP

## For agents

- [For agents](https://docs.basaltvault.app/reference/for-agents.md): start a run with an intent, check status, follow nextSteps, never retry a refusal blindly
- [MCP tools](https://docs.basaltvault.app/reference/mcp-tools.md): every tool, its arguments, its result and its errors
- [Error codes](https://docs.basaltvault.app/reference/errors.md): every error code and reason, and what the agent and the person do next
- [When something is refused](https://docs.basaltvault.app/guides/refused.md): troubleshooting for refused, held, stale read, row limit, intent missing and timeout

## How it works

- [Architecture](https://docs.basaltvault.app/concepts/architecture.md): the engine runs next to your agent, the guard runs inside your Postgres
- [Runs](https://docs.basaltvault.app/concepts/runs.md): one job with one stated reason; what you review and undo
- [Rules](https://docs.basaltvault.app/concepts/rules.md): what the agent may do by default, and what is held or refused
- [Approvals](https://docs.basaltvault.app/concepts/approvals.md): how a held write waits for a passkey signature
- [The ledger](https://docs.basaltvault.app/concepts/ledger.md): what is recorded for every action, and for how long
- [Undo](https://docs.basaltvault.app/concepts/undo.md): how undo works when rows changed after the agent

## Guides

- [Hosts](https://docs.basaltvault.app/guides/hosts.md): which connection string and role to use with Supabase, RDS or your own Postgres
- [A bot on its own computer](https://docs.basaltvault.app/guides/bot-own-computer.md): set up a bot on a machine you cannot reach
- [Passkeys](https://docs.basaltvault.app/guides/passkeys.md): register a passkey on the setup page and check it
- [See what it did](https://docs.basaltvault.app/guides/see-what-it-did.md): read what an agent did, through the run_history and list_runs tools
- [Undo a run](https://docs.basaltvault.app/guides/undo.md): the agent previews an undo, and the person signs it on the revert page
- [Upgrade](https://docs.basaltvault.app/guides/upgrade.md): upgrade basalt, and update the guard from the setup page
- [Remove BasaltDB](https://docs.basaltvault.app/guides/remove.md): remove the guard, ledger and roles from the setup page

## Reference

- [CLI](https://docs.basaltvault.app/reference/cli.md): the commands an agent or a service runs (init, mcp, version) and their flags, and exit codes
- [Configuration](https://docs.basaltvault.app/reference/config.md): engine.json keys, environment variables, paths and role names
- [Change record](https://docs.basaltvault.app/reference/change-record.md): the record kept for every action, field by field
- [Limits and defaults](https://docs.basaltvault.app/reference/limits.md): row limits, hold thresholds, timeouts, expiries and retention

## About

- [FAQ](https://docs.basaltvault.app/faq.md): short answers to common questions
- [What BasaltDB won't catch](https://docs.basaltvault.app/limits.md): the mistakes it does not stop
- [Security](https://docs.basaltvault.app/security.md): how to report a vulnerability
- [License](https://docs.basaltvault.app/license.md): Apache-2.0

## For contributors

Design records for people working on the code, not user help.

- [README](README.md): what BasaltDB is, what it is not, and the milestone status
- [Install guide](docs/install.md): setup on a person's own computer, update and removal
- [Bot setup](docs/bot-setup.md): the steps for an agent on a computer no person can reach
- [CONTRACT.md](CONTRACT.md): the index of the normative contract for MCP tools, the CLI, the pages and the basalt_meta schema. It lists the section files under contract/; read the index, then only the sections you need
